summary: Captured two lessons learned from the 40 item usage/dormant audit into the wonder-cookbook skill and CB-bigquery data-research-patterns playbook: (1) trailing 'F' suffix on 40* item numbers is a real distinct frozen-variant item, not an annotation to strip, and (2) R&D/DRAFT status alone can't determine whether a menu item is a stale test draft or active WIP -- needs human confirmation. Also documented that item_version_change_logs.is_system_action under-flags known service accounts (SCC_SYNC, Wonder Create).

Wrote a new personal workflow skill 'check-40-item-dormant-candidacy' distilling this session's entire 40 item/menu item dormant-audit process (usage query, Excel sheet building, dormant confirmation sheet, 90-day human-edit recency check, F-suffix and is_system_action gotchas), plus a matching recognition rule wired into CLAUDE.md.

Updated 'A2-Data Research/Uncutover 40 Item Usage Analysis.md' to reflect the full evolution of the analysis: Menu Item Dormant Confirmation (152 items) and B2B 88 Dormant Confirmation (78 items) sheets, No usage 40 items (244) sheet, 90-day human-edit recency checks, and the F-suffix data quality correction (Not sold 40 scope 405->408).

Updated 'A2-Data Research/Uncutover 40 Item Usage Analysis.md' again to reflect sheet consolidation (HDR Recipe Dormant Confirmation merged into Menu/7 Dormant Confirmation, 159 rows) and the removal of 29 already-DORMANT rows from No usage 40 items (244->215).

Updated 'A2-Data Research/Uncutover 40 Item Usage Analysis.md' to cover the new 'Has usage 40 items' sheet (171 items), the usage-data staleness finding (3 items whose usage disappeared due to deleted menu items or BOM edits), the redo of the Menu_7 Dormant Confirmation merge, and the Excel auto-converting the fullwidth slash sheet-name character to an underscore.

Queried secure-recipe-prod for menu items where the Multi versions vs options line-build toggle (is_multiple_version=true) resolves to just 1 line build, as stakeholder evidence for removing the toggle per Line Build Multi-Version & Multi-Usage Toggles Analysis. Found zero such cases: all 13 current (effective=true, non-dormant, non-preset) toggle-on items have 3+ real branches.
questions: Should the stakeholder evidence instead use the reports already-proven identical-content-across-branches (cheese case) angle rather than single-line-build?
learned: version_status=EXPIRED does not occur on secure-recipe-prod.recipe_v2.item_versions for MENU items; historical superseded versions stay version_status=FINAL with effective=false, sold_status=NOT_SOLD instead, so effective=true is the correct current-version signal, not version_status filtering
No live/current menu item has is_multiple_version=true with only 1 distinct line_build_id; minimum observed is 3 branches
Item 8008463 branch count changed from 5 (in the 2026-08-07 report) to 10 as of today; new draft item 8012287 (Grilled Sirloin 10oz Double, The Mainstay) now also has the toggle on with 5 branches
